note: Private test build for DeSmuME (Animal Crossing, goal 10x at 59-60+ fps stable) on the verified 834, with the Azahar work the maintainer asked to include and nothing else from the other sessions. The libretro collection LibretroCores-e5378e84 replaces LibretroCores-f5857282: desmume_libretro (asynchronous 3D, desmume_rb_3d_async auto by default: a render slower than 8 ms is drawn into a second buffer while the 2D shows the last finished one, never near a display capture; both screens written into the frontend's memory through GET_CURRENT_SOFTWARE_FRAMEBUFFER; [rb-perf] defer and direct; docs/desmume-arm64-jit-architecture.md section 16.7) and azahar_libretro (each frame of the libretro_vk pool owns its output image) change. The libretro bridge hands DeSmuME two shared Metal buffers in turn, copied into the frame's texture by the GPU, and lends Vulkan images a core keeps per sync index straight to the presenter (Azahar, no copy). Every other component, and every other bridge, is the 834's. Nothing measured on an iPhone.
